title: Argentinian Stew
description: A hearty and flavorful stew originating from Argentina, made with chicken and warm spices. This dish is perfect for a chilly evening.
instructions: Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add chicken and cook until browned on both sides, about 5 minutes.
Add onions and garlic to the pot and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add red bell peppers and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Stir in cumin, smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Add chicken broth and tomato paste, scraping up any browned bits from the bottom of the pot.
Return chicken to the pot and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, for 20-25 minutes, or until chicken is cooked through.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh cilantro if desired.
